name: opencore-config-audit
description: 审查、修改与维护黑苹果的 OpenCore EFI 配置与驱动安装：BIOS/UEFI 审查、逐键对照官方文档、ACPI/SSDT 巡检、kext 精简、引导日志与启动耗时取证、系统大版本升级（含网卡 kext 的 MinKernel/MaxKernel 版本分流）、磁盘屏蔽，以及 NVIDIA / Intel 无线 / MediaTek / 博通网卡、AppleALC 声卡、HiDPI、Intel 睿频、Intel 混合架构开小核/关小核（E 核）、内存定制、SMBIOS 三码等驱动与硬件特性，以及启动界面外观（OpenCanopy 主题：图标集、PickerAttributes、Flavour、标签/字体/音频/背景）。
description_en: Audit, edit and maintain a hackintosh OpenCore EFI configuration and its driver installs: BIOS/UEFI settings audit, per-key verification against the official docs, ACPI/SSDT review, kext trimming, boot-log and boot-timeline forensics, major macOS upgrade planning (including per-Darwin-version kext gating with MinKernel/MaxKernel), disk masking, plus NVIDIA / Intel WiFi / MediaTek / Broadcom cards, AppleALC audio, HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost, Intel hybrid-architecture E-core enable/disable, memory injection SMBIOS/serials, and OpenCanopy boot-picker theming.
